explanation: Generated a 3x3=9 point grid for eta electroproduction (ep -> e'peta) at W=[1.55,1.65,1.75] GeV, Q2=[0.5,1.0,1.5] GeV2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg. All kinematic ranges are within EtaMAID-2023 table bounds (W: 1.486-6.0 GeV, Q2: 0-5.0 GeV2). The eta production threshold is 1.486 GeV, so all W points are above threshold. WARNING: A known bug exists in maid_lee (exclurad.F:4248-4249) where m_pi is set to the pion mass (m_pip=0.13957 or m_pi0=0.13498 GeV) instead of the eta mass (0.54786 GeV) for the iphy=3 configuration. This affects the kinematic calculations E_pi_cm and ppi_mag_cm inside maid_lee, which in turn affect the hadronic response functions. The main kinematic framework in bornkin correctly uses the eta mass (amunm=0.54786) via setcon, and the EtaMAID table interpolation itself only depends on Q2 and W, so the bug is localized to the kinematic conversion in maid_lee. The source file is read-only and could not be patched in-place.
